It is carried out by AGC Biologics A/S of Denmark, and the Colorado site in the U.S. has been withdrawn.
entries.27ef632f5977b204: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells flat glass for buildings and processed architectural glass such as insulated glass, tempered glass and laminated glass. It is carried out by AGC Glass Building Materials Co., Ltd., AGC Glass Products Co., Ltd., PT Asahimas Flat Glass Tbk, AGC Glass Europe, AGC Flat Glass Czech a.s. and others. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales to external customers were ¥438,811 million, segment profit (operating profit) was ¥17,263 million, the number of employees was 12,697, capital expenditure was ¥33,085 million and R&D expenses were ¥4,366 million. The company explains that in Europe and the Americas, although there was a revenue decrease from lower shipments in Europe and from the transfer of the Russian business in February 2024, the revenue-increasing effects of pricing policies and the weaker yen outweighed it, and that in Asia results fell below the previous year owing to lower shipments and lower selling prices in Indonesia and elsewhere. It cites expanding sales of highly insulating, heat-shielding products such as Low-E insulated glass and vacuum insulated glass as a challenge.
entries.28081ec7afe239f7: A reportable segment that handles contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) of synthetic pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, contract development and manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, and intermediates and active ingredients for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals. It is carried out by AGC Biologics A/S (Denmark) and others, and in Japan the Chiba Plant has manufacturing facilities for synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates and active ingredients and for biopharmaceutical drug substances. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales to external customers were ¥129,420 million and the segment result was a loss of ¥22,261 million, the only loss among the reportable segments. The number of employees was 2,967, capital expenditure was ¥28,140 million and R&D expenses were ¥1,088 million. The company explains that although the synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical CDMO business performed firmly, revenue decreased because of the absence of one-time income from the settlement of a contracted project recorded in the previous year in the biopharmaceutical CDMO business and the closure of the Colorado site in the U.S., among other factors. Winning orders in the animal cell field of biopharmaceutical CDMO, which accounts for half of this business's sales, is a challenge, and the company expects to return to profitability in 2027.

entries.2b5247a4d8265568: This is a reportable segment consisting of the 'Display' business, which handles glass substrates for liquid crystal and organic EL displays and specialty glass for displays, and the 'Electronic Materials' business, which handles semiconductor-related and optical-related materials. AGC Electronics Co., Ltd., AGC Techno Glass Co., Ltd., Aijiexu Xianshi Boli Gufen Youxian Gongsi (Taiwan), Aijiexu Xianshi Boli (Huizhou) Co., Ltd., Aijiexu Xinxing Dianzi Xianshi Boli (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., AGC Fine Techno Korea Co., Ltd. and others are responsible for it. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥353,227 million, and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥47,536 million, the second-largest profit scale among the reportable segments. The number of employees was 10,832, capital expenditure was ¥52,937 million, and R&D expenses were ¥13,326 million, the largest R&D expenses among the five reportable segments. The company explains that the Display business exceeded the previous year due to higher shipments of glass substrates for liquid crystal displays, while the Electronic Materials business fell below the previous year because Optoelectronics was in a transition toward further higher functionality and shipments of EUV exposure photomask blanks declined; it also states that operating profit was affected by costs recorded in connection with the decision to withdraw from the chemically strengthened specialty glass business.
entries.2d27332100cff12d: The AGC Group consists of the company, 192 subsidiaries and 26 affiliates, and it has established 6 companies by product and service: "Architectural Glass Europe and Americas," "Architectural Glass Asia," "Automotive," "Electronics," "Chemicals," and "Life Science." Under a structure in which each company formulates comprehensive strategies in Japan and overseas for the products and services it handles and develops business activities globally, the company system was introduced in 2002. The reporting segments are 5, combining the 2 architectural glass companies into 1, and in addition there are Ceramics and Others, which are not included in the reporting segments. Its corporate philosophy is "Look Beyond," and under it, it raises "Our Purpose: 'AGC, always an essential part of our world.'" In 2016, the company defined its existing businesses as "core businesses" and its new business groups in growth fields as "strategic businesses" and promoted ambidextrous management, and in 2021 it formulated its long-term management strategy, "Our Vision for 2030." At present, based on the medium-term management plan "AGC plus-2026" formulated in February 2024, it aims to build a business portfolio that is resilient to market fluctuations and has high asset efficiency, growth potential and carbon efficiency. The company has revised downward its financial target for 2026, operating profit of ¥230 billion, from the initial level on 2 occasions, in February 2025 and as of the submission of this report, citing as reasons the economic downturn in China and Europe, a large shortfall in sales volume in the life science business, a shortfall against sales targets in the electronic materials business (photomask blanks for EUV lithography, optoelectronics), and price weakness in the Essential Chemicals Southeast Asia business. Its customers are wide-ranging, including construction, automobiles, displays, semiconductors, and pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, and there is no single counterparty accounting for more than 10% of net sales to external customers.

entries.5d3633b5b1a506d7: The main products and services are architectural flat glass and processed architectural glass, automotive glass and in-vehicle display cover glass, glass substrates for liquid crystal and organic EL displays, semiconductor-related and optics-related materials, caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride resin, urethane raw materials, fluorine products and iodine products, and contract development and manufacturing of synthetic pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals and biopharmaceuticals. Group-wide R&D expenses for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥60,324 million, broken down into Corporate ¥20,013 million, Electronics ¥13,326 million, Chemicals ¥11,271 million, Automotive ¥6,899 million, Architectural Glass ¥4,366 million, Life Sciences ¥1,088 million and Ceramics and Others ¥3,357 million. The company promotes “ambidextrous development,” which means pursuing both “right-handed development” that strengthens existing businesses and “left-handed development” that opens new markets by applying existing technologies it holds, and has used materials informatics (materials development using computational and information science) since early on. Capital expenditure was ¥251,279 million, broken down into Chemicals ¥90,197 million, Electronics ¥52,937 million, Automotive ¥43,058 million, Architectural Glass ¥33,085 million and Life Sciences ¥28,140 million. The company has made capital investments of more than ¥200 billion each year from 2018 through 2025; it states that these large-scale investments were concluded in 2025, and that from 2026 it will sharply curb new investment to focus on maximizing the use of existing facilities and recovering its investments.

The business that started from sheet glass leads to the current Architectural Glass segment (net sales to external customers of ¥438,811 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025) and the Automotive segment (¥520,324 million for the same period). The Amagasaki site of the Kansai Plant still has manufacturing equipment for electronic glass.
entries.f10c6f9fd3c689a9: In 1917, it started manufacturing soda ash, a raw material for glass.
entries.f32154afcef11765: A division that handles semiconductor-related materials and optical-related materials. It supplies EUV exposure photomask blanks and CMP slurry for the front-end processes of semiconductor manufacturing. The company states that optoelectronics is in a transition period toward higher functionality and that semiconductor-related materials are generally continuing to grow, and that it will now also focus on back-end semiconductor processes, expanding semiconductor packaging-related technologies and solutions by leveraging its strength of holding inorganic materials, organic materials, and functional design and processing technologies in an integrated manner.

entries.fea59b8249828f60: Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 based on the location of bases were Japan ¥652,144 million, Asia ¥646,856 million, Europe ¥515,825 million, and the Americas ¥244,006 million (including Brazil).

entries.ffc9753367c485f4: This is a division that handles glass substrates for liquid crystal / organic EL displays and specialty glass for displays. Related companies in Taiwan, Huizhou (China), Shenzhen (China) and Gumi (Korea) are responsible for manufacturing and selling glass substrates. The company states that profitability has steadily improved through business restructuring and strengthened competitiveness based on pricing policy and technological innovation. Additionally, the company has decided to withdraw from the chemically strengthened specialty glass business.
